text: Shows the 02:00 UTC scheduled start and the extract from the read replica of orders whose updated_at is later than the high-water mark minus 2 hours.
Shows how repeated extracts of the same order are loaded so the warehouse keeps one row per order_id with its latest version, and re-runs do no harm.
Shows the high-water mark kept in the warehouse and advanced only after a successful load.
Shows the failure path: up to two retries 15 minutes apart, then paging on-call after the third failed attempt.
Shows soft-deleted orders kept in the warehouse with an is_deleted flag rather than removed.
Shows the 06:00 UTC deadline: dashboards never see half-loaded data, and a staleness alert goes to #data-alerts if the load hasn't committed.
Shows the Sunday reconciliation over the last 30 order-creation days (row count and checksum) and how mismatched days are reloaded.
Delivered as a Mermaid flowchart with short notes before or after it.
